boss_1.name: OpFor: Armor
abilities: Randomly selects a target and fires in a line, dealing Arts damage

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles for an extended time and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>
[Deathswarm] Periodically summons drones
Hidden Core
[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] OpFor: Armor enters its final form after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

boss_2.name: OpFor: Gun
abilities: Attacks prioritize units with the highest DEF
Attacks inflict Corrosion
Cannot be blocked.
ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same enemy repeatedly
[Final Judgment] Stops attacking and gains greatly increased Movement Speed, charging at the unit with the highest DEF and dealing Physical damage to units it passes by
Hidden Core

[Unending Confession] After fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round in the simulation, <'Gunshatter'> appears on the field, and Physical and Arts damage taken by <OpFor: Gun> is significantly reduced

[Blind Faith] Connects to all <'Gunshatters'> on the field; a percentage of damage taken by <'Gunshatters'> is transferred to <OpFor: Gun>, and allied units on the [Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
[Doomsaying] Continuously calls all <'Gunshatters'> towards it; <'Gunshatters'> gain greatly increased Movement Speed, become immune to damage, and deal damage to allied units that they pass by

boss_3.name: OpFor: Pipe
abilities: When on the field, continuously summons <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form; summon interval reduces when HP drops below a certain point
Attacks prioritize <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form
[Cracked Pipe] Attacks all <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form three times in a row, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
Hidden Core
<OpFor: String> and <OpFor: Pipe> will appear at the same time after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

boss_4.name: Sal Viento Bishop Quintus
abilities: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
[Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
[Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
[Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
[Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

boss_6.name: Alistair, Final Flame of the Empire
abilities: When HP drops below half, DEF and RES increase, and [Imperial Domain] activates two pieces of gear
[Expulsion] After some time has passed, deals Arts splash damage to all your units, and drains all Life Points
[Royal Decree] Locks onto an allied unit and their surrounding 4 tiles, dealing heavy Physical damage to targets within that range once and generating random gear on tiles within that range
[Imperial Domain] Activates a piece of gear on the field; different types of gear will result in different effects

boss_7.name: 'Samivilinn,' the Resolution of the Very North
abilities: [Icicle Fall] Attacks deal Physical damage to allied units in a column
[Surge of Nature] Inflicts Stun on an allied unit and causes the target to take Arts damage over time
After falling below half HP, takes reduced Physical and Arts damage and [Icicle Fall] and [Surge of Nature] both target an additional unit

boss_8.name: OpFor: Armor
abilities: Randomly selects a target and performs an Arts attack
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK within range, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
[Deathswarm] Periodically summons drones
Hidden Core
[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] OpFor: Armor enters its final form after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

boss_9.name: OpFor: Gun
abilities: Attacks prioritize units with the highest DEF
Attacks inflict Corrosion
Cannot be blocked.
ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same enemy repeatedly
[Final Judgment] Stops attacking and gains greatly increased Movement Speed, charging at the unit with the highest DEF and dealing Physical damage to units it passes by
Hidden Core

[Unending Confession] After fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round in the simulation, <'Gunshatter'> appears on the field, and Physical and Arts damage taken by <OpFor: Gun> is massively reduced

[Blind Faith] Connects to all <'Gunshatters'> on the field; a percentage of damage taken by <'Gunshatters'> is transferred to <OpFor: Gun> and other <'Gunshatters'> on the field, and allied units on the [Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
[Doomsaying] Continuously calls all <'Gunshatters'> towards it; <'Gunshatters'> gain greatly increased Movement Speed, become immune to damage, and deal damage to allied units that they pass by

boss_10.name: OpFor: Pipe
abilities: When on the field, continuously summons <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form; summon interval reduces when HP drops below a certain point
Attacks prioritize <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form
[Cracked Pipe] Attacks all <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form three times in a row, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
Hidden Core
<OpFor: String> and <OpFor: Pipe> will appear at the same time after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

ba.addash.name: Move
ba.addash.desc: Cannot leave the field; will deploy at the target location with the current HP

ba.addbullet.name: Replenish
ba.addbullet.desc: Replenishes ammo for other Operators' ammo-type skills; an ammo-type skill can only be replenished up to its max ammo capacity during a single activation of that skill

ba.airprotect.name: Anti-Air Sanctuary
ba.airprotect.desc: Reduces incoming Physical and Arts damage from aerial units by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.attract.name: Lure
ba.attract.desc: Cannot be blocked and moves towards the target's position

ba.barrier.name: Barrier
ba.barrier.desc: Absorbs a certain amount of damage.

ba.berserk.name: Tenacity
ba.berserk.desc: Increases stats proportionally based on lost HP, reaching the maximum bonus once a certain percentage has been lost (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.binding.name: Tied
ba.binding.desc: When the corresponding Tied unit is no longer on the battlefield, this unit's skill immediately ends, SP is set to 0, and SP can no longer be gained

ba.buffres.name: Status Resistance
ba.buffres.desc: <$ba.stun>Stun</>, <$ba.cold>Cold</>, and <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> durations halved; <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> loses 1 stack every 5s (does not stack with the same effect)

ba.camou.name: Camouflage
ba.camou.desc: Prevents being targeted by normal enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking (but will still take Splash damage)

ba.charged.name: Charged
ba.charged.desc: Can continue recovering SP after reaching the maximum. When SP reaches double the maximum, enters Charged state. Skills have additional effects when activated in Charged state (All SP will be consumed whenever the skill is activated)

ba.cold.name: Cold
ba.cold.desc: Reduces ASPD by 30 and causes subsequent applications of the Cold status during the debuff duration to inflict <$ba.frozen>Frozen</>

ba.costlowerbound.name: DP Lower Limit
ba.costlowerbound.desc: DP can drop below the DP Lower Limit; when DP is below 0, natural DP regeneration rate -50%

ba.dmgresistance.name: Damage Reduction
ba.dmgresistance.desc: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.dt.apoptosis.name: Necrosis
ba.dt.apoptosis.desc: After Necrosis reaches 1000, the affected unit cannot use skills for 15 seconds and every second loses 1 SP and takes 100 Arts damage

ba.dt.apoptosis2.name: Necrosis - Ally
ba.dt.apoptosis2.desc: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), inflicting 50%<$ba.weaken>Enfeeble</> that gradually recovers, and dealing 800 Elemental Damage per second. 15s cooldown.

ba.dt.burning.name: Burn
ba.dt.burning.desc: After Burn reaches 1000, the affected unit has its RES reduced by 20 for 10 seconds and takes 1200 Arts damage

ba.dt.burning2.name: Burn - Ally
ba.dt.burning2.desc: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 7000 Elemental Damage and temporarily inflicting -20 RES. 10s cooldown.

ba.dt.erosion.name: Corrosion
ba.dt.erosion.desc: After Corrosion reaches 1000, the affected unit has its DEF permanently reduced by 100 and takes 800 Physical damage

ba.dt.erosion2.name: Corrosion - Ally
ba.dt.erosion2.desc: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 5000 Elemental Damage and permanently reducing DEF by 120 (stacks). 8s cooldown.

ba.dt.neural.name: Nervous Impairment
ba.dt.neural.desc: After Nervous Impairment reaches 1000, the affected unit takes 1000 True damage and is <$ba.stun>Stunned</> for 10s

ba.dt.neural2.name: Nervous Impairment - Ally
ba.dt.neural2.desc: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 6000 Elemental Damage and inflicting 3 stacks of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</>. 10s cooldown.

ba.dt.rampage.name: Rampage
ba.dt.rampage.desc: When Rampage reaches 1000, ASPD +50 for 15 seconds, but takes 100 True damage per second (rising by 50 with each attack, up to 600)

ba.dying.name: Critically Wounded
ba.dying.desc: Movement Speed reduced, cannot be blocked, dies after 10s, restores SP to the attacker when defeated.

ba.elementfragile.name: Elemental Fragility
ba.elementfragile.desc: Amplifies all Elemental Damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.epbarrier.name: Protective Barrier
ba.epbarrier.desc: Absorbs a certain amount of <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Injury</>.

ba.fear.name: Fear
ba.fear.desc: Cannot be blocked and runs off uncontrollably

ba.fever.desc: Once Fever reaches 450, whenever any <$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</> member's skill is manually activated, all <$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</> members on the field will keep their current skill activated for 20s

ba.float.name: Low-Altitude Hovering
ba.float.desc: Cannot be blocked or attacked by melee attacks

ba.fragile.name: Fragile
ba.fragile.desc: Amplifies all Physical, Arts, and True damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.frozen.name: Frozen
ba.frozen.desc: Unable to move, attack, or use skills (inflicted through the <$ba.cold>Cold</> status); When enemies are frozen, RES -15

ba.groundbind.name: Grounded
ba.groundbind.desc: Target becomes a ground unit and cannot move; causes some Low-Altitude Hovering enemies to drop. Duration halved if Weight is greater than 3

ba.inspire.name: Inspiration
ba.inspire.desc: Increases base stats (only the strongest effect of this type applies for each stat)

ba.invisible.name: Invisible
ba.invisible.desc: Prevents being targeted by enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking

ba.levitate.name: Levitate
ba.levitate.desc: Target becomes aerial and cannot move, attack, or use skills. Duration halved if Weight is greater than 3.

ba.liftoff.name: Take Off
ba.liftoff.desc: Cannot block ground enemies and will not be attacked by them; can block flying enemies

ba.magicarcane.name: Arcane Surge
ba.magicarcane.desc: Increases Arts damage dealt (only the strongest effect with this name applies)

ba.magicfragile.name: Arts Fragility
ba.magicfragile.desc: Amplifies all Arts damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.mujica.desc: Includes Sakiko Togawa, Umiri Yahata, Uika Misumi, Nyamu Yūtenji, Mutsumi Wakaba

ba.overdrive.name: Overload
ba.overdrive.desc: Skill duration has two gauges. Extra effect is triggered when skill duration is halfway complete.

ba.palsy.name: Paralysis
ba.palsy.desc: Each stack of Paralysis can interrupt an enemy when it attempts to perform a normal attack, max 3 stacks; Paralysis has unlimited duration when not consumed, but units with status resistance lose 1 stack every 5s

ba.permanentatk.name: Continuously Attack
ba.permanentatk.desc: Continuously attacks, regardless of whether there is a target within Attack Range

ba.physicfragile.name: Physical Fragility
ba.physicfragile.desc: Amplifies all Physical damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.protect.name: Sanctuary
ba.protect.desc: Reduces incoming Physical and Arts damage by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.shield.name: Shield
ba.shield.desc: Blocks 1 instance of damage per layer of Shield

ba.sleep.name: Sleep
ba.sleep.desc: Invulnerable and unable to take any actions

ba.slowdown.name: Sluggish
ba.slowdown.desc: Movement Speed, ASPD, activation and cooldown speed of certain skills, and recovery speed from certain negative statuses are reduced by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.steal.name: Steal
ba.steal.desc: Reduces the target's base stats while increasing own. The reduction and increase in stats cannot exceed the specified upper limit (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.strong.name: Vigor
ba.strong.desc: Increases stats when HP is above a certain percentage (only the strongest effect of this type applies)

ba.stun.name: Stun
ba.stun.desc: Unable to move, block, attack, or use skills

ba.tremble.name: Frighten
ba.tremble.desc: Cannot perform normal attacks when blocked

ba.triggereffect.name: Trigger effect
ba.triggereffect.desc: A one-time debuff or buff placed on an enemy or allied unit; it activates only when specific conditions are met

ba.weaken.name: Enfeeble
ba.weaken.desc: Reduces the target's ATK by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect with this name applies)

ba.weaknessatk.name: Weakness damage
ba.weaknessatk.desc: When dealing Physical or Arts damage, changes damage type depending on the target's DEF and RES

ba.weightless.name: Weightless
ba.weightless.desc: Weight reduced by 1 level (effects of the same name do not stack)
